thread:
elaine: FYI incoming from Acme — intermittent 429s & token errors on their dedicated pool (pool-id: dp-eu2-07). They see tail latency jumps ~4-5s and occasional OOMs. Posting logs below. :eyes:

sam: Can you paste the root request id and approx timestamps? Also any repro steps?

elaine: Root request id: r-0a1b2c3d. Happened ~2026-03-15T18:42:12Z and ~18:49:30Z. Customer says it started after they scaled up batch jobs. Attached snippet:

elaine:
```
2026-03-15T18:42:12Z ERROR model-handler: failed to acquire GPU context: timed out after 5000ms
2026-03-15T18:42:12Z WARN scheduler: queue wait 4.2s for req r-0a1b2c3d
2026-03-15T18:42:12Z INFO kvcache: miss for prefix X
```

support-bot: Ticket #INC-4921 created -> https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-4921

sam: Can infra-bot grab node-level MIG configs + nvidia-smi outputs for nodes in dp-eu2-07? Suspect noisy neighbor / MIG fragmentation.

infra-bot: Collected nodes: node-88, node-92, node-95. Attaching quick dump:
```
node-88: nvidia-smi -L
GPU 0: A100-SXM4 (UUID: GPU-...)
  MIG 0g.20gb Device 0000:65:00.0
  MIG 1g.10gb Device 0000:65:00.1
node-92: similar
node-95: 2x 1g.10gb + 1x 7g.40gb
```

mike: Those MIG mixes look fragmented. If scheduler tries to pack larger inference jobs after autoscale events we can get colocated heavy 7g slices + many 1g slices causing PCIe contention and tail latency.

elaine: Customer repro steps they provided:
1) Pin model v3.2 on dp-eu2-07
2) Start 10 rps small-ctx generators (fast) + 2 long-context batch jobs simultaneously
3) After ~20m latency spikes and some 429s

sam: Try running stress repro on node-95 with this script to simulate their workload:
```
# stress-repro.sh
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"v3.2","input":"short"}' & done
# and run two processes with long contexts
```

mike: Also check dmesg on node-95; we saw GPU page-fault retries in similar incidents. Run:
```
sudo dmesg | grep -i nvrm
```

dave: Short-term mitigation: bump reserved capacity for Acme to isolate to nodes node-88 only or set pool policy to strict-host-affinity. That will avoid mixed MIG packing while we root-cause.

elaine: I proposed that to the customer, they asked for ETA and whether billing will be impacted. They said they saw extra 429s during a high traffic spike and want credits if internal autoscaler caused it.

sam: From logs autoscaler did a scale-down 2026-03-15T18:35Z then scale-up at 18:40Z. If scale-down removed extra 7g slices, scheduler might have rebalanced small tasks onto remaining slices causing contention. Need to verify placement decisions in orchestrator trace for these timestamps.

infra-bot: Orchestrator traces for job placements: https://internal.redwood.ai/trace/trace-77b2

mike: Repro succeeded on node-95 in our lab: when run mixed workload, tail latency jumped to 3.8s and we saw 'failed to acquire GPU context' in logs. Root cause: MIG fragmentation + kernel pinned processes contending on PCIe. Plan: (1) short-term strict isolation for Acme (2) change autoscaler cool-down to 10m to avoid tight down-up cycles (3) scheduler change to prefer homogeneous MIG packing.

dave: I'll open an internal change request for autoscaler cool-down and scheduler preference. Also recommend temporary credit for customer while we mitigate. @elaine can you coordinate with billing? :+1: 

elaine: Will open support ticket update and propose 10% credit for incident window. Updating INC-4921 with mitigation steps and repro logs. cc: @mike attaching kernel/dmesg output.

mike: dropping the exact remediation commands:
```
# pin customer to node-88
redwoodctl pools set-affinity dp-eu2-07 --node node-88
# change autoscaler cooldown
redwoodctl autoscaler update --pool dp-eu2-07 --cooldown 600
```

support-bot: Updated INC-4921 status -> investigating -> assigned to sam, mike

elaine: customer accepted the isolate + credit proposal, will run with node-88 for 24h and report. :relieved:

sam: follow-up: schedule a postmortem next week, include mq and placement traces. Filed PM: PM-2026-83

dave: thanks team. keeping this open until 2026-03-17 12:00Z for validation.
